points.quote: Misuse of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Tools: any suspected misuse of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) will be dealt with under this policy.
points.gist: Any suspected misuse of GenAI is handled under this misconduct policy.

points.quote: In most instances misuse of GenAI would fall under the definition of plagiarism (either through failing to appropriately reference sources (i.e. GenAI) or presenting work that is not student’s own as if it were) but could also fall under the definition of dishonest practice where appropriate.
points.gist: GenAI misuse usually counts as plagiarism, by not referencing GenAI or presenting work as one's own, but may also be dishonest practice.

points.quote: The relevant Discipline Committee will follow Table 9.2 when determining an outcome for forms of Contract Cheating and inappropriate use of GenAI tools (as listed above):
points.anchor: 9.2 Contract Cheating and inappropriate use of GenAI tools
points.gist: Discipline Committees use Table 9.2 to decide outcomes for contract cheating and inappropriate GenAI use.

points.quote: Inappropriate and unethical usage of Large Language Modules (LLMs) and any artificial intelligence technology.
points.gist: Inappropriate and unethical use of LLMs and any AI technology is listed among matters for the Discipline Committee.

points.quote: This applies to students who have previously been cited for Contract Cheating and inappropriate use of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tools, regardless of when the previous offence occurred.
points.gist: Repeat-offence penalties apply to students previously cited for inappropriate GenAI use, whenever the earlier offence occurred.

points.quote: The University may allow reassessment for less severe offences but will not permit for major offences of contract cheating or and inappropriate use of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tools.
points.gist: Reassessment may be allowed for less severe offences but not for major offences of inappropriate GenAI use or contract cheating.
